title: Food Crimes
blurb: Cold pizza at midnight, five-second rules and the biscuits you hid from guests.

prompts: eaten a whole pizza alone in the car
dipped a chip into something that was clearly not a dip
eaten ice cream for breakfast
put sauce on something that really did not need it
licked the plate when no one was watching
eaten cold leftovers standing in front of the open fridge at midnight
double dipped at a party
stolen a chip off someone else's plate without asking
put pineapple on a pizza and defended it to the death
hidden a snack so my family wouldn't find it
told someone I loved their cooking and then ordered takeaway on the way home
eaten something that had been in the fridge for over a week
bought a fancy ingredient for one recipe and watched the rest expire
scraped the burnt bit off my toast into the sink and eaten it anyway
dropped food and applied the five-second rule to a full minute
eaten dessert first and skipped the main
made a second dinner because the first looked disappointing
picked every mushroom or onion out of a meal and left a sad little pile
eaten so many free samples at the supermarket that it counted as lunch
wiped sauce on my jeans because there were no napkins
eaten an entire block of chocolate in one sitting
cooked pasta and ended up with a glue-like blob
mistaken salt for sugar in a recipe and served it anyway
followed a recipe video and made something that looked nothing like it
claimed a dish was a family recipe when it came from a packet
ordered a salad and then ordered chips for the table "to share"
drunk from someone else's cup by mistake
burnt my tongue on soup because I was too impatient to wait
ordered the giant meal challenge and not finished it
tasted a grape in the supermarket before buying
put the good biscuits aside for myself and put out the boring ones for guests
put something weird in the air fryer just to see what would happen
buried a wrapper at the bottom of the bin so nobody could see what I ate
eaten more cookie dough than ever made it into the oven
mixed every sauce sachet into one and called it a creation
ordered delivery from the same place twice in one day
started a diet at breakfast and abandoned it by lunch
made a toastie with at least five fillings that had no business being together
gone back for thirds at a buffet
opened a tin expecting one thing and found something else
cut the mouldy bit off the bread and eaten the rest
eaten all the icing off a cupcake and left the rest
said "just one bite" and finished the entire thing
taken a photo of a dish that looked amazing and tasted terrible
used a fork on something I knew was meant to be eaten with hands
eaten a pie on the footpath outside a shop because I couldn't wait
reheated a takeaway in the microwave until it was basically a brick
